whatsappMessage:
Hi Food Heaven Cafe & Sudha Ice Parlour Team,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.8★ reviews at Dak Bungalow Chauraha in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct table reservations or party orders.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme instant WhatsApp table booking, ice cream & menu showcase, aur Google Maps directions integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/foodheaven

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
